label: caiso 94 daytime clean
definition: CAISO KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-18, owner-authorized swap from caiso-93 -- a DIAGNOSTIC-turned-keeper promoted on rule-1 structural grounds: the most structurally-faithful CAISO recipe on record, not the lowest-error one; determination stays NOT-YET). caiso-93 keeper recipe + caiso_dsw_daytime_clean: the measured daytime trigger-OFF (hod 6-21) WEIM clean-transfer depth on the south corridor (5441/5762/5998 MW 2023/24/25, raw Palo Verde hub no-wheel, EF 0, net of firm + caiso-87 surplus + caiso-93 overnight, trigger-OFF DISJOINT from caiso-87; zero fitted parameters; FINDING-caiso94-daytime-wedge-2026-07-17). Verified vs the caiso-93 keeper it supersedes: C3a mean-LMP HELPS (2025 +13.3->+11.0%, toward the <=10% band, still FAIL), C1 holds 12/12 (free 8/8), C2/C3b PASS, the caiso-93 overnight lambda and the C3c tail (FAIL, ~unchanged) both HOLD, C4 stays FAIL, C6/C7/C8 PASS. Pre-registered COST, surfaced not tuned (rules 1/11/23): C5a CO2 DEEPENS from the caiso-93 keeper's CAVEAT (commercial-band) to FAIL in all three years (2023 -13.3%, 2024 -11.2%, 2025 -16.5%) as the EF-0 daytime clean import displaces CC gas -- surfacing, not hiding, the model's CC-underproduction root cause; the evening lambda (hod 17-21) deepens further under, -0.6/-0.9/-1.2pp. 2023-2025.
market_story: Through the daytime trigger-OFF hours (hod 6-21, outside the tight afternoon peak the model leaves alone) the Desert-Southwest runs a non-emitting surplus -- spring and autumn solar and wind spilling east of the Colorado -- and the WEIM/EDAM greenhouse-gas attribution assigns that surplus to the transfers CAISO imports on the south corridor, so the marginal daytime import pays NO unspecified-import carbon adder and no point-to-point wheel: it clears at essentially the raw Palo Verde hub price. CC_REGULAR: California's own combined-cycle fleet backs down through these hours to the residual the clean interties cannot serve -- the belly over-price closes because the real marginal daytime import is cheaper than the carbon-wedged rung the model used to charge, not by a floor. imports: the south corridor carries an additional ~5.4-6.0 GW of measured clean daytime transfer (trigger-OFF hours only, net of the firm block and the caiso-87 surplus and caiso-93 overnight tranches, all disjoint). CO2: because the displacing daytime import is zero-emission, the model's in-state CO2 falls further below eGRID -- the honest signal that the fleet's gas classes under-produce vs the metered fleet (CC now import-displaced, CT/CHP chronically), the promotion's chartered root-cause lane, never a reason to throttle a measured clean transfer.
